newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight - Three new orders, no fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight - Three new orders, no fixtures.

text.p: Sugar freight market had a calm day on Tuesday with just a few new orders cited. But there were no fixtures.
Brokers said shipments out of Brazil had slowed down dramatically with activity centred in West coast Central America.
Dreyfus quoted 18,814 tonnes bulk sugar cargo from Taiwan to Crockett for 17-25 February. It also had a 5,800-tonne Puerto Quetzal/New Orleans for the same dates.
An unnamed trading house was looking for a monthly COA for 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar from Santos to Aqaba throughout the rest of the year.
